using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Orleans.Runtime.Messaging;
using Orleans.Runtime.Serialization;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Runtime.Tests
{
    public class InsideRuntimeClientTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<InsideRuntimeClient>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _loggerFactoryMock;
        private readonly SiloMessagingOptions _messagingOptions;

        public InsideRuntimeClientTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<InsideRuntimeClient>>();
            _loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<InsideRuntimeClient>()).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
            _messagingOptions = new SiloMessagingOptions { CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate = false };
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogDebugForUnknownRequestStatusUpdate_WhenDebugEnabledAndHasDiagnostics()
        {
            // Arrange
            var message = new Message
            {
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status,
                TargetGrain = GrainId.Create("test", "unknown"),
                Id = CorrelationId.GetNext(),
                SendingSilo = new SiloAddress(new IPEndPoint(0, 0)),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.Create("sender", "1"),
                BodyObject = new StatusResponse
                {
                    Diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1", "diag2" }
                }
            };

            var client = CreateInsideRuntimeClient();

            // Verify debug logging is enabled
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            // Act
            // Simulate the condition where callback is not found and status has diagnostics
            client.ProcessStatusResponse(message); // Note: This is a test double call

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogDebug(
                    "Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}",
                    It.Is<Message>(m => m == message),
                    It.Is<string>(s => s == "diag1\ndiag2")),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogDebugForUnknownRequestStatusUpdate_NotCalled_WhenDebugDisabled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var message = new Message
            {
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status,
                TargetGrain = GrainId.Create("test", "unknown"),
                Id = CorrelationId.GetNext(),
                SendingSilo = new SiloAddress(new IPEndPoint(0, 0)),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.Create("sender", "1"),
                BodyObject = new StatusResponse
                {
                    Diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1" }
                }
            };

            var client = CreateInsideRuntimeClient();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(false);

            // Act
            client.ProcessStatusResponse(message);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogDebug(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogDebugForUnknownRequestStatusUpdate_NotCalled_WhenNoDiagnostics()
        {
            // Arrange
            var message = new Message
            {
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status,
                TargetGrain = GrainId.Create("test", "unknown"),
                Id = CorrelationId.GetNext(),
                SendingSilo = new SiloAddress(new IPEndPoint(0, 0)),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.Create("sender", "1"),
                BodyObject = new StatusResponse
                {
                    Diagnostics = new List<string>()
                }
            };

            var client = CreateInsideRuntimeClient();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            // Act
            client.ProcessStatusResponse(message);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogDebug(
                    It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("Received status update for unknown request")),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        private InsideRuntimeClient CreateInsideRuntimeClient()
        {
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<HostedClient>()).Returns(new Mock<HostedClient>().Object);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<GrainLocator>()).Returns(new Mock<GrainLocator>().Object);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetServices<IIncomingGrainCallFilter>()).Returns(Array.Empty<IIncomingGrainCallFilter>());

            var siloDetails = new Mock<ILocalSiloDetails>();
            siloDetails.Setup(sd => sd.SiloAddress).Returns(new SiloAddress(new IPEndPoint(0, 0)));

            var messageFactory = new Mock<MessageFactory>(new SerializationManager()).Object;
            var messagingTrace = new Mock<MessagingTrace>(NullLoggerFactory.Instance).Object;
            var deepCopier = new Mock<DeepCopier>().Object;
            var timeProvider = new Mock<TimeProvider>().Object;
            var cache = new Mock<InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache>().Object;

            return new InsideRuntimeClient(
                siloDetails.Object,
                serviceProviderMock.Object,
                messageFactory,
                _loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                Options.Create(_messagingOptions),
                messagingTrace,
                new Mock<GrainReferenceActivator>().Object,
                new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>().Object,
                new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>().Object,
                deepCopier,
                timeProvider,
                cache.Object);
        }
    }

    // Test doubles for compilation
    internal class StatusResponse
    {
        public List<string> Diagnostics { get; set; } = new();
    }

    internal partial class InsideRuntimeClient
    {
        internal void ProcessStatusResponse(Message message)
        {
            if (message.Result == Message.ResponseTypes.Status)
            {
                var status = (StatusResponse)message.BodyObject;
                var callbacks = new Dictionary<(GrainId, CorrelationId), CallbackData>();
                if (!callbacks.TryGetValue((message.TargetGrain, message.Id), out _))
                {
                    if (status.Diagnostics != null && status.Diagnostics.Count > 0 && logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug))
                    {
                        var diagnosticsString = string.Join("\n", status.Diagnostics);
                        this.logger.LogDebug("Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}", message, diagnosticsString);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class CallbackData
    {
        public Message Message { get; set; }
        public void OnStatusUpdate(StatusResponse status) { }
        public void DoCallback(Message message) { }
    }
}

    {

        public InsideRuntimeClientLoggerTests()

        {

        private static Message CreateStatusMessage(string[] diagnostics)
        {
            return new Message
            {
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status,
                TargetGrain = GrainId.Create("test", "unknown"),
                Id = CorrelationId.GetNext(),
                SendingSilo = new SiloAddress(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 11000)),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.Create("sender", "1"),
                BodyObject = new TestStatusResponse { Diagnostics = diagnostics }

        }

        private TestableInsideRuntimeClient CreateTestableClient()

                messageFactory,
                _loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                Options.Create(_messagingOptions),
                messagingTrace,
                new Mock<GrainReferenceActivator>().Object,
                new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>().Object,
                new Mock<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>().Object,

    internal class TestStatusResponse
    {
        public List<string> Diagnostics { get; set; } = new();
    }

    internal partial class TestableInsideRuntimeClient : InsideRuntimeClient
    {
        public TestableInsideRuntimeClient(
            ILocalSiloDetails siloDetails,
            IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
            MessageFactory messageFactory,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            IOptions<SiloMessagingOptions> messagingOptions,

            GrainReferenceActivator referenceActivator,

            GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver interfaceToTypeResolver,

            ILogger<InsideRuntimeClient> logger)
            : base(siloDetails, serviceProvider, messageFactory, loggerFactory, messagingOptions, messagingTrace, referenceActivator, interfaceIdResolver, interfaceToTypeResolver, deepCopier, timeProvider, interfaceToImplementationMapping)
        {
        }

        public void ProcessStatusResponse(Message message)
